verdict.rationale: Fedora's Workstation page states this capability directly: all the packages, tools and runtimes a developer might need are up to date and ready to use with a single command. Supporting claims cover easy package install, update and management, and container tools that need no setup. Missing for 10: first-party detail on the actual command or package manager and which runtimes are covered, plus independent or hands-on confirmation that developer stacks install in one step.
